description_en: Sets the defense mode for frequency control (HTTP flood mitigation) of a website service
description_zh: 设置网站业务频率控制防护（CC防护）的防护模式
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo config-web-cc-template --domain www.aliyun.com --template default --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigWebCCTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website service.
The domain name must have a website forwarding rule configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The defense mode for frequency control (HTTP flood mitigation). Valid values:
default: Normal.
gf_under_attack: Emergency.
gf_sos_verify: Strict.
gf_sos_enhance: Super Strict
parameters.help_zh:
频率控制防护（CC防护）的防护模式。取值：
default：正常
gf_under_attack：攻击紧急
gf_sos_verify：严格
gf_sos_enhance：超级严格
parameters.name: template
